principle: For event-specific campaigns the Director evaluates real seller/event media BEFORE deciding to manufacture a collage. A real photograph taken by a person is more convincing than unnecessary synthetic composition (Owner, 2026-09-10). Collage is a fallback, never the default.

provenance_gate.rule: Every candidate must be bound to the campaign's event_id before scoring. Media from any other event, seller, or a stock source is never a candidate. An asset whose event binding cannot be shown is excluded, not scored low.

tiers.label: Excellent seller/event cover image
eligibility: is_photograph (not a composed graphic: text/logo contamination ≤ 1 small watermark-class region, no headline-class text)
hard_gates: subject_integrity: primary subject not cut by the frame edge in the required crops
tiers.notes: Many seller 'cover images' are the seller's own finished advertisements. Those fail is_photograph and are routed to the published-anchor role (negative similarity anchor), never used as a photograph. The West University Facebook cover is the recorded example.

tiers.label: Excellent seller-uploaded walkthrough/video frame
eligibility: frame selected by the frame-selection pipeline (never the first frame by default)
hard_gates: no person/hand/phone occupying > 5% of the frame
aspect: 4:5 or 1:1 crop keeps the subject
min_source_height_px >= 1080 after crop, or the format is downscaled honestly (no upscaling beyond 1.25×)

tiers.label: Strong authentic environmental photograph
tiers.source: event.site_photographs[] (seller-uploaded or seller-published for THIS event)

tiers.label: Multiple strong authentic environmental photographs
eligibility: each photograph passes tier 3 hard gates
layouts: primary + one secondary (never a 3-tile grid unless the family explicitly allows it)
sequential creative (LAUNCH uses photo 1, MID uses photo 2) preferred over multi-tile

tiers.label: Individual merchandise images requiring editorial composition
tiers.source: CLEAN extracted objects of THIS auction (3M extraction gate) — the 3M.3 scene families with Phase 3P.1 physical intelligence
eligibility: ≥ 3 CLEAN objects with semantic classes resolved (Mission 4)
scene plan passes the physical audit (Mission 5)
tiers.when: Tiers 1–4 have no candidate ≥ readiness_threshold, OR the campaign is a notable-lot / category spotlight where object photography is the point, OR the Director records a factual reason the environment should not be shown.

tiers.label: Restrained branded factual creative when source media is inadequate
tiers.source: no merchandise imagery; brand frame + event facts (event type, title, date/time, place) + optional single CLEAN lot photograph as a small inset
tiers.rule: Never manufacture a collage to avoid this tier. A quiet factual creative is an acceptable outcome; an implausible collage is not.

algorithm: 1. Enumerate all event-bound media; drop anything failing the provenance gate or is_photograph (composed graphics → anchor role).
2. Score every candidate on its tier's criteria; apply hard gates first (a failed gate = not ready, not 'low').
3. Walk tiers 1 → 6; select the first tier with a ready candidate (score ≥ readiness_threshold). Within a tier choose the highest score; ties → the more representative.
4. A lower tier may override a higher one only with a recorded reason (e.g. tier-1 cover is a tight detail shot; tier-3 room shows the sale better) and the score difference must exceed 10.
5. Record the full decision trail in the packet: every candidate, its scores, gates failed, the tier chosen, the reason, and why collage was or was not built.
6. Owner review flag when: the chosen tier is 2 (first three uses), the override rule fired, or all media scored < 60.
never: use media not bound to this event_id
use a composed seller graphic as a photograph
default to collage because objects exist
pick the first frame of a video by position
enhance media in a way that invents detail (no generative fill, no super-resolution > 1.25×); crop, straighten, exposure and white balance only

scoring_normalisation.sharpness_norm: variance of the Laplacian of the luminance, divided by the 90th-percentile value across the event's own media set (so a set of soft phone photos still ranks internally) and clamped to [0,1]; absolute floor: Laplacian variance ≥ 300 at 1200px long edge
scoring_normalisation.clutter: detector or vision-judge count of: cardboard boxes, cables, plastic bags, price stickers, people, phones, trash, cleaning items; each instance −3, capped at −18
scoring_normalisation.invitation: vision-judge 0–4: would a buyer want to walk into this room; scaled to the criterion weight
scoring_normalisation.aspect_suitability: the subject bounding region (furniture + art mass) must fit inside a 4:5 and a 1:1 crop with ≥ 90% of its area retained
